cues.en: A lot of people don't realize that change is a two way street. You can come to us with $16.0.25,
cues.zh: 很多人没意识到，换零钱其实是双向的。你可以拿 16 个 25 美分硬币来找我们，

cues.en: 8 dimes, and 4 nickels. We can give you a $5 bill. We can give you five singles or two singles, 2, and 10 dimes. You'd be amazed at the variety of options you have.
cues.zh: 再加上 8 个 10 美分和 4 个 5 美分。我们可以给你一张 5 美元纸币，也可以给你五张 1 美元，或者两张 1 美元、两枚 1 美元硬币外加 10 个 10 美分。换零的选择之多，绝对会让你大吃一惊。

cues.en: I was driving through Pennsylvania on the tollway and to save time I was using the exact change lanes.
cues.zh: 我当时正开车行驶在宾夕法尼亚的收费公路上，为了省时间，我一直走的是“请备零钱”车道。

cues.en: I had just run out of 0.25 and I was getting a bit nervous when I spotted a sign for a citywide branch at the next exit.
cues.zh: 我的 25 美分硬币刚好用光了，心里正有点发慌，就在下一个出口看到了 Citywide 分行的路牌。

cues.en: it's a pretty good feeling. I've had people come in with wrinkled $10 bills who want new crisp bills to put in birthday cards.
cues.zh: 这种感觉挺不错。有人拿着皱巴巴的10美元钞票来找我，想换成崭新的票子，好放进生日贺卡里。

cues.en: And we can handle special requests like that, usually the same day. I just returned from a business trip to London, and all the cash I had was a £5 note.
cues.zh: 这类特殊要求我们都能处理，通常当天就能办好。我刚从伦敦出差回来，身上带的现金只有一张5英镑钞票。

cues.en: Citywide wasn't able to convert it to dollars, but they did give me 4 guineas, 2 crowns, 4 shillings and 10p.
cues.zh: Citywide没法把它兑换成美元，但他们给了我4几尼、2克朗、4先令和10便士。

cues.en: All the time our customers ask us, how do you make money doing this? The answer is simple,
cues.zh: 我们的客户总会问我们：你们怎么靠这个赚钱？答案很简单，
这就是我们的赚钱方式。
